name: Template change persists after navigating away and back
description: A logged-in user opens a CV, changes the template from the default to a different one, navigates away to CV history, then returns to the same CV and verifies the selected template and CV data are still intact.

planSteps.description: Enter testsprite@gmail.com in the email field
Navigate to the CV history page
Open the existing CV for editing
Verify the CV preview is currently visible and rendered with content, not a blank white area
Change the template selector to a different template than the current one
Verify the CV preview updates to reflect the newly selected template's distinct visual layout
Navigate to the CV history page
Open the same CV for editing again
Verify the previously selected template is still applied and the CV preview shows content, not a blank white area
